text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install all-way stop control at the intersections of Rajah Street with Sultana Avenue and Baycrest Avenue. Based on the assessment undertaken, the installation of all-way stop control is recommended at both intersections and should enhance safety for all road users.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Rajah Street and Sultana Avenue. 2. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Rajah Street and Baycrest Avenue.
